limitations: These are bounded functional gates. Banks, partial reuse, disk KV and embedded MTP remain opt-in/present rather than broadly qualified; MTP Auto remains off.
Banks use plain target state. Serial MTP is a separate mode and does not support multiple banks or external predictor files; draft limit is three.
The edited bank arithmetic returned 4 on both warm and cold paths. Cache parity passed; the requested arithmetic answer did not.
The counting responses ended with finish_reason=length at 48/128 tokens. Byte-identical truncated output does not establish completion or general answer quality.

No speedup is claimed. Single raw samples were 3.038 seconds with MTP versus 2.758 seconds plain; the 2492-token counting samples were 19.915 versus 14.137 seconds. These are not repeated performance measurements.
Serial MTP unaligned append replayed all 17 prompt tokens and correctly reported cached_tokens=0 with state-replay miss. Exact restart restored all 14 raw prompt tokens.
HTTP cancellation was one disconnect after first content, followed by successful exact-cache recovery; it is not a concurrency or disconnect-stress campaign.
The longest new bank/MTP context here is 4096. Historical plain allocation/throughput evidence does not qualify these modes at 262144 or 524288 tokens.

All model shard content hashes were verified; native executable hashes were not recorded per run. Raw receipts are local scratch artifacts, and HTTP PID-to-endpoint ownership is an operator assertion.
